candidates.title: sign_in_existing_account_clarity
candidates.change: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen clarifying how to sign in with an existing account to avoid creating duplicate empty accounts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, pointing to account sign-in confusion.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account method to keep your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Valid sign-in hint addition clarifying account access.

candidates.score_note: High support email volume (8) and drop-off at sign_in step; quick copy fix via config.

candidates.title: waiting_screen_progress_estimate
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and progress indicators on the waiting screen while the pet is being prepared.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off before pet delivery.

guard.reason: Valid progress indicator and real wait estimate on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Funnel highlights long wait duration at home step, but no support email evidence.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_visibility_check
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing desktop verification steps.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mentioned pets not displaying on desktop after completing setup, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Your pet is now live on your desktop!
home_intro.body: Check your desktop taskbar and screen to confirm your pet has spawned.

guard.reason: Valid home intro redesign within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off and 3 support emails, but full redesign requires new release.

candidates.title: story_screen_split_layout
candidates.change: Switch the intro story screen to a split layout highlighting companion choices visually.
candidates.why: The choose_path stage has 76.2% conversion and a mean duration of 514s, indicating slow initial user orientation.

guard.reason: Valid story screen layout redesign within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Funnel shows slow choose_path orientation; layout redesign requires client release.

candidates.title: photo_upload_preview_verification
candidates.change: Add a new image verification screen right after photo upload to confirm upload quality before pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails cited custom pet rendering errors, and adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.

upload_photos.hint: Preview your uploaded images to make sure your pet turns out great.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_photo_check']

candidates.title: sign_in_after_pick_friend
candidates.change: Reorder sign-in to occur right after pet selection instead of before path choice.
candidates.why: Sign-in has 72.9% conversion early on; letting users pick their pet first builds motivation before sign-in.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to save your newly chosen pet companion.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in step permitted by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Previous test on sign_in reorder yielded negative lift (-5.6%); low confidence.

candidates.title: adoption_trait_customization_flow
candidates.change: Insert a trait selection sub-flow during adoption where users select personality traits for their pet.
candidates.why: Adoption step drop-off is high (60.9% conversion) with 1017s mean time, needing deeper engagement during adoption.

pick_friend.hint: Select your pet's base character before customizing personality traits.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_traits']

candidates.title: waiting_ready_notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users know when generation is complete.
candidates.why: Mean waiting time is 2336s, leading users to leave the desktop app unattended or get lost.

waiting.hint: We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid notification option added to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time on home step; funnel evidence only.

candidates.title: home_intro_interaction_tips
candidates.change: Add clear hint text on the home intro screen detailing mouse shortcuts for pet controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls, settings, or chat.

guard.reason: Valid helpful interaction hint added to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has low conversion (64.8%) and 3 support emails; cheap text update.

candidates.change: Update copy on choose_path screen to explicitly distinguish between pre-made pets and custom photo pets.
candidates.why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between path choices.
